stale_records.reconciliation_reason: orchestrator PID 78643 absent; active-runs registry empty; preserved incomplete run as died

root_cause: Dead processes can remain marked live because the durable run state files under ~/.ringer/runs are independent forensic records. active-runs.json is pruned against pid liveness, but that pruning does not update old run JSON. Ringside /api/runs scans ~/.ringer/runs/*.json with scan_hud_run_states() and returns each JSON object largely verbatim, so any abruptly terminated orchestrator that left state='live' and finished=false can still appear live unless a separate reconciliation step rewrites or projects it as died.
